project.title: Shotgun metagenomic sequencing of activated sludge microbiome for microbial diversity and functional analysis
project.description: This project aims to investigate the microbial community succession and functional responses of activated sludge under combined environmental stresses and C8-HSL-mediated recovery. Activated sludge samples were collected from a sequencing batch reactor treating synthetic wastewater under low temperature, low dissolved oxygen, low carbon-to-nitrogen ratio, and alkaline conditions, with or without exogenous C8-HSL addition. Shotgun metagenomic sequencing was performed to characterize microbial diversity, functional genes, and metabolic pathways associated with nitrogen and phosphorus removal, extracellular polymeric substances (EPS) synthesis, and microbial stress adaptation. The metagenomic data provide insights into the mechanisms by which C8-HSL regulates microbial communities and enhances the resilience of activated sludge systems under complex environmental stresses.
